stories.title: Power Grab or Fiscal Discipline? Trump's $810 Million Pocket Rescission Ignites Constitutional Showdown
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Takes Historic Action to Kill Wasteful Spending as Swamp Screams
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Illegally Seizes Congress's Power of the Purse, Even Republicans Say
stories.poll_question: Can the president cancel funding Congress already approved?
stories.poll_option1_desc: President should have power to stop wasteful spending Congress rubber-stamped.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Only Congress controls spending; this is lawless impoundment of approved funds.

stories.title: Vindication or Witch Hunt? Jack Smith Faces Senate Republicans Over Trump Prosecutions
stories.conservative_headline: Jack Smith Squirms as Senators Expose His Partisan Crusade Against Trump
stories.liberal_headline: Jack Smith Stands Firm as Republicans Gaslight America About Jan. 6
stories.poll_question: Were the Jack Smith prosecutions of Trump legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Smith weaponized DOJ to take down a political opponent.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Smith followed evidence and did his job without fear or favor.

stories.title: Securing Removals or Shipping People to Danger? SCOTUS Greenlights Third-Country Deportations
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Hands Trump Major Win: Bad Day for Criminal Illegals
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Lets Trump Deport People to Countries They've Never Seen
stories.poll_question: Should migrants be deportable to countries they have no ties to?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Removal orders must be enforced; destination shopping is a loophole.
stories.poll_option2_desc: People deserve a hearing before being sent somewhere dangerous and unfamiliar.

stories.title: Worker Shortage or Trump Slowdown? Economy Adds Just 29,000 Jobs as Unemployment Climbs
stories.conservative_headline: Wages Steady, Jobs Added as Trump Economy Powers Through Global Energy Shock
stories.liberal_headline: Hiring Collapses to 29,000 as Wage Growth Hits Five-Year Low Under Trump
stories.poll_question: Who is responsible for the slowing job market?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Global energy shocks and labor supply limits, not White House policy.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs and chaos crushed hiring while paychecks lost ground to prices.

stories.title: Ending It Fast or Forever War? Trump Sends 9,000 More Troops to the Middle East
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Projects Strength: Iran War Will End 'Very Quickly' as Forces Surge
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Admits He's Timing the Iran War Around the Midterm Elections
stories.poll_question: Is escalating in Iran the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Overwhelming force is the fastest path to ending the conflict.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Another open-ended war with no congressional authorization or exit plan.

stories.title: Protecting Elections or Purging Voters? SCOTUS Clears Trump's Voter Database as Judge Strikes Noncitizen Ban
stories.conservative_headline: Judge Says Banning Noncitizen Voting Is Unconstitutional — Let That Sink In
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Gets Green Light for Mass Voter Purges Weeks Before the Midterms
stories.poll_question: Is the new federal voter verification push legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Verifying citizenship protects every legal vote from being cancelled out.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Faulty databases will strip eligible Americans from the rolls.

stories.title: Big Oil Accountability or Lawfare Shakedown? Supreme Court Takes Up Climate Liability Suits
stories.conservative_headline: SCOTUS May Finally End Blue-State Lawfare Campaign Against American Energy
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Could Hand Big Oil Blanket Immunity for Climate Destruction
stories.poll_question: Should oil companies face lawsuits over climate damage?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Climate policy belongs in Congress, not in activist courtrooms.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should cover the damages they caused.

stories.title: Obamacare Rebate or Election-Year Bribe? Treasury Starts Mailing $500 Checks
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers: $500 Checks Returning Obamacare Cash to Working Families
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Dangles $500 Checks After Gutting the Health Coverage Americans Rely On
stories.poll_question: Are the $500 Obamacare refund checks good policy?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Returning cash beats funneling premiums into a broken insurance scheme.
stories.poll_option2_desc: One-time checks can't replace the coverage and subsidies being cut.

stories.title: Innovation First or Corporate Capture? Trump Renames AI 'Super Intelligence' and Picks Jay Clayton as Czar
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Unleashes American Super Intelligence, Rejects Europe-Style Red Tape
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Lets AI Giants Write Their Own Rules — and Rebrands the Technology for Them
stories.poll_option1_desc: Heavy regulation hands the AI race to China and kills innovation.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Self-regulation by trillion-dollar firms is no regulation at all.

stories.title: Protecting National Security or Punishing Dissent? Visa Crackdown Freezes Columbia Journalism Admissions
stories.conservative_headline: Columbia Feels the Heat as Trump Ends Visa Pipeline for Radical Activist Campuses
stories.liberal_headline: Trump's Visa War Shutters a Storied Journalism Program's Admissions
stories.poll_question: Are the visa restrictions on universities justified?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Visas are a privilege; elite schools shouldn't import agitators on taxpayer goodwill.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing universities over politics guts American research and press freedom.
